scenes.setting: Every bullet and flame dissolves against the altar's light and the Shepherd dismisses him as a worm — until Klein finds the one thing he has left and throws the Master Key inside, where its shell melts away and the curse within reaches back to Mr. Door

Audrey watches the iron-black fog creep toward Empress Borough until a Storm-summoned hurricane and downpour scour Backlund clean — while Lady Despair, content with twenty thousand dead and a mostly digested potion, prepares to slip away, and finds a black-haired, dull-faced young woman sitting opposite her in the carriage

scenes.setting: The dissolving key screams with Mr. Door's voice: the resentment feeding the ritual is contaminated, the barrier collapses, and the altar tears itself apart — Klein rides out the blast behind a paper substitute and a wall, sees the half-destroyed Shepherd already regrowing, and runs
scenes.text_anchor: As a result, the altar lost its balance and embarked on a path of self-destruction!
